profile.headline: Lead Software Developer / Software Architect.
profile.summary:
Full Stack Web Application Developer (Angular to SQL Server)
Goal-oriented and highly motivated Software Engineer with over 25 years of experience in the conception, design, programming, and implementation of Graphical User Interfaces (GUI), server-client communication, and back-end applications.

Core Competencies:
Programming Languages: .NET Core, .NET Web API, TypeScript, Angular, JavaScript, Tableau, C#, C++, WCF, XML, Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF), and Prism (MVVM).
Concepts: Object-Oriented Analysis and Design (OOA&D), UML, Design Patterns, Refactoring, and Unit, Module, and Systems Level Testing.
Applications: Certified in NG Agile 101. Proficient in Jira, Scrum Master, SVN, MS Visio, Enterprise Architect (EA), Toad, PrimeNG, DevExpress Angular, Azure DevOps Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) Pipeline, Git, DevExtreme, and System Configuration Management.
Databases: MS SQL Server, MySQL, SQL Server Data Tools (SSDT), and Data Migration.
Mapping Applications: FalconView, Google Earth API, Google Maps API, Gallium Map.
Documentation Skills: SRS (Software Requirements Specification), SDD (Software Design Document), SDP (Software Development Plan).
Additional Skills and Studies: Document Object Model (DOM), XML, UML, Microsoft Foundation Class (MFC), Standard Template Library (STL), Windows Forms, WPF, Prism, LINQ, ADO.NET, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), server-client communication, TCP/IP, UDP, C# Design Patterns, Log4Net, NUnit, Web Services, Microsoft DirectShow, and Test Automation Software.

Passionate about language education, I aim to positively impact their growth, build their confidence, and create a supportive learning environment in the community.
